argv: Capture from Chronicle and the journal (HC1-HC15, decision 0112; JN1-JN24, decision 0155)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and an Android phone, with a journal whose last entry is from yesterday (so today's date sits under it) and several placed entries from walks, force-quit and open Memories; then scroll back a little. **Expect:** nothing moves as the entries' places appear; today's date, inside the last box, scrolls with the page on native (it is not held there, unlike the dates above). Never run on a device: the peek and the empty page in one box (`restBox`), `maintainVisibleContentPosition` with the box as the last child. (fix entry-jitter 2)
